title: Strict henselization quotients are free over base quotients
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with maximal ideal n, and let A^{\mathrm{sh}} be its strict henselization with respect to a separable closure of the residue field [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples]. There is a set X such that, for every r\ge1, the A/n^r-module A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r is free on the images of X; consequently the inverse limit T=\varprojlim_r A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r is canonically isomorphic to \varprojlim_r ((\bigoplus_{x\in X}A)/n^r(\bigoplus_{x\in X}A)), the n-adic module completion of the free A-module \bigoplus_{x\in X}A (where this completion is defined by the displayed inverse limit), and T is the n-adic ring completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] of A^{\mathrm{sh}}.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), part (4), and the completion identification in Lemma Tag 06LJ(c)

proof.text: Choose a basis of the separable closure K of the residue field A/n over A/n, and choose lifts X in A^{\mathrm{sh}}. By [lem-sc-strict-henselization-faithfully-flat] the map A\to A^{\mathrm{sh}} is flat, while [lem-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-triples] identifies the maximal ideal of A^{\mathrm{sh}} with nA^{\mathrm{sh}} and its residue field with K. For each r\ge1 we have (nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r=n^rA^{\mathrm{sh}}, so A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r=A^{\mathrm{sh}}\otimes_A A/n^r is a flat A/n^r-module, as a base change of a flat module (Algebra, Tag 00HI). The ring A/n^r is local with nilpotent maximal ideal n/n^r, and the reduction of A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r modulo n/n^r is A^{\mathrm{sh}}/nA^{\mathrm{sh}}=K, an A/n-vector space with basis the images of X. Thus the hypotheses of [lem-weil-pbc-local-artinian-basis-when-flat], condition (1), hold for R=A/n^r, M=A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r and the images of X.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), part (4), using Algebra Tag 051F

proof.text: Applying [lem-weil-pbc-local-artinian-basis-when-flat] at each r gives that A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r is free over A/n^r on the images of X. This is exactly the quotient assertion, including the same set X for every r because the chosen lifts are fixed in A^{\mathrm{sh}}.

Let F=\bigoplus_{x\in X}A. The basis isomorphisms F/n^rF \cong A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r commute with the reduction maps because every basis vector is sent to the fixed image of x. Taking inverse limits therefore identifies the n-adic completion of F, namely \varprojlim_r F/n^rF, with T=\varprojlim_r A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r. Hence T is the n-adic completion of F. Finally, since nA^{\mathrm{sh}} is an ideal of A^{\mathrm{sh}}, the ring T=\varprojlim_r A^{\mathrm{sh}}/(nA^{\mathrm{sh}})^r is by [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] (with ideal nA^{\mathrm{sh}}) the n-adic ring completion of A^{\mathrm{sh}}; the identification above is one of A-modules.
